text:
elena: quick triage — proposing a lightweight bring-up for cinder-8b (community fork). goal: L3/fast-onramp only, 1-2 day smoke + gate decision. asking for quant owner + perf owner.
krish: ok from infra side. can run a smoke perf pass tomorrow. what are the concrete gates? :thinking_face:
elena: gates i have in mind: 1) inference latency P95 within 20% of slate-8b baseline on same hw (p2-small), 2) token-generation regression (perplexity) <= +6% on our news/dev evals, 3) embeddings similarity >= 0.92 cosine on small semsearch set, 4) quantized q4/q8 doesn't blow up hallucinations on 50 prompt checks.
marc: runtime note — cinder exports an attention kernel that needs small patch for cached KV layout. i'll try to land a compatibility shim but want to keep the smoke lossy (no heavy compile). if we see huge perf delta i'll flag.
sara: i'll own quant experiments. plan: run q8 and q4o for latency/cost matrix + q4_kv for memory. quick checklist:
- prepare eval set (jin)
- run q8 smoke (sara)
- run q4 smoke if q8 promising
- sanity quality checks (jin + elena)

jin: prepping a trimmed eval: 200 prompts across chat, summarization, search. will include 50 targeted prompts for known hallucination modes. pushing list to gdoc: https://redwood.example/gdocs/cinder-smoke
deploy-bot: model-queue updated: cinder-8b added (owner:sara). estimated runtime slots: tomorrow 0900-1300 PT.
krish: command i'll run for perf smoke (copying here):
```
./bench/run_smoke.sh --model cinder-8b --hw p2-small --batch 1 --seq 512 --iters 250 --quant none
```
krish: and for quant quick:
```
./bench/run_smoke.sh --model cinder-8b --quant q8 --hw p2-small --batch 1 --seq 512 --iters 250
```
elena: good. scoring heuristics for prioritization (for PM backlog):
- product impact: 2/5 (internal UX + search)\n- infra effort: 1/5 (small shim)\n- cost upside vs slate: 3/5\n- risk (quality): 3/5
=> composite: 2.25 -> L3. but if quant improves latency >10% and quality on par, can bump to L2.
sara: timeline: today prep evals, run q8 tomorrow morning, share artifact + perf table by EOD tomorrow. if perf looks close, i'll run q4_kv on Tue.
marc: note — will monitor kernel fallback logs. if we get many fallback-to-slower-path, that'll explain regressions. pls include `--trace-kernels` in perf runs.
jin: added small automated regression check in the gdoc. i'll run a quick scoring script that outputs: perplexity delta, embedding cosine mean, hallucination flag count.
ci-bot: smoke-run completed (staging): 1713543333. results artifact: s3://redwood-smoke/cinder-8b/1713543333/results.json
elena: awesome. when results are in, can someone post the key numbers here? i'll make a quick gating call. if any gate fails, we drop to backlog and annotate follow-ups.
krish: posting numbers (raw): median latency 142ms, P95 188ms (slate-8b baseline P95 170ms), perplexity delta +4.5%, embed cosine 0.934, hallucination flags 3/50.
sara: q8 run: P95 192ms, perplexity +5.1%, embed cosine 0.928. q4_kv tentative run queued.
marc: kernel trace shows 8% of steps hitting fallback slow path — likely due to rotary param layout mismatch. created issue: https://redwood.example/issue/ML-872
elena: decision: marginal on latency (P95 +10%). quality within our smoke gates. action: accept into L3 onboarding with 'follow-up kernel fix' ticket and plan a canary test on dedicated pool before any public release. owners: sara (quant), marc (runtime), jin (evals), krish (perf infra). i'll add to roadmap board.
sara: noted. i'll run expanded quality suite during canary and produce eval PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
jin: will close the smoke eval and attach the final report to the ticket.
krish: will schedule a 2-hour canary slot next week and ping infra.
elena: closing this thread — thanks team. will post the L3 card and link to results.
note: Slack thread single-string messages; root message at thread_ts; short, informal exchanges; includes bots and code snippets
